An unmarked '''space yacht''' was used by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Callista Ming]] to travel from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[Mulako Corporation Primordial Water Quarry]] [[Comet/Legends|comet]], then the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], and, finally, the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], where it was heavily damaged.
